PLAY-REC-D279-INSPECTION-YARD-CONTACT-001
Player exact instruction at accepted Day279 dawn camp: "Continue". Previous Day278→279 intimate overnight with Mara and Fenar was accepted, wilderness Short Rest already completed, LongRest3/6, no Day279 ration/feed debit or Day279 road encounter roll. At Day279 breakfast V's three eating companions Mara/Cirren/Fenar consume3 person-rations, four healthy owned horses4 animal-feed-days, reducing stored21→18 ration-person-days and28→24 feed animal-days (six travel days remain); V Reborn no food use. Sella independently breaks Harrow & Pike company camp and leads her existing three freight wagons, three drivers incl Sella/Idra/Tollen and two hired company guards including Nara, with V's separately owned four-horse coach alongside on the normal maintained Caer Veylan→Eastwatch inland road, loaded-freight pace. Day279 heavily patrolled road chance declared DAY d100 01–07 before RNG; genuine successful Python secrets.uniform d100 FACE90 => NO random daytime encounter. No type/severity draw. There is nevertheless a previously positioned independent local civilian/military freight issue at the FIRST staffed eastbound inspection/receiving lay-by, six road miles from prior camp, reached after normal roughly2–3 hours of travel at about Day279 10:00AM. This is an onstage FIXED world event triggered by arriving at its fixed location, NOT a rerolled random encounter or invented pursuit from earlier gnolls/trolls/WTR quest. Yard 80ft north from road with 20ft unobstructed public bypass lane, no automatic hold/detain/search of V. Harrow & Pike wagons stop for ordinary manifest checks with Sella managing own work; V's party remains with own coach and can choose to help or go. Local adult civilian supply-wagon forewoman ELEN TURR publicly protests to Veyran Guard-profile logistics sergeant ADREN VOS that SIX iron stretcher-frame fittings she carries have been contracted and paid for a civilian convalescent home; Vos insists on checking yard military transport-case inventory before releasing contested material. Two ordinary logistics guards stand at gate, civilian checker at office, Elen's two civilian loaders beside their wagon; no weapon drawn, no assaults, no actual loss of items, no transfer seizure. Elen calls to commercial convoy leader Sella to witness the disputed ownership/transfer, not to V by name; Sella independently says she'll ask the checker rather than automatically take sides. Public documents have NOT yet been compared, hidden private route code/other evidence not made available to V and no new conclusion about authority or secret program. Party agency: V may hear arguments, request appropriate documents, speak to parties, follow Sella, or remain uninvolved and proceed when own company check done. Time ~10AM Day279, next player decision unmade. Everyone uninjured: V48/48HP HD7/7 full Sup4/4, Psi6/6, MP7/7 and fighter abilities; Cirren51/51HD6/6 full spell slots; Fenar59/59HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3; Mara healthy; four healthy horses+coach intact; V purse969gp3sp6cp, carried rations18/feed24, one sealed unused Pixie Dust. LongRest3/6. No new rest, money, spell, feature, gear/custody or encounter combat. Prior resolved Day278 campfire/overnight entries were independently verified and pruned from current recovery journal in background, and already live in main owning CAMPAIGN_STATE; do not duplicate them. Ordinary first contact is not yet a natural sync milestone, and current journal gets no sync_trigger.

PLAY-REC-D279-INSPECTION-YARD-BOTH-QUESTIONED-001
Exact player instruction at Day279 ~10:00 FIRST staffed freight inspection lay-by east of Day278 camp: "What’s going on? Ask both". V chooses to walk over and question both adult civilian forewoman Elen Turr and Veyran logistics Sergeant Adren Vos about their public argument; he does not yet offer arbitration, accept dangerous work, demand sealed records, choose sides, spend resources or promise compensation. By approximately10:05, ELEN freely describes her six iron stretcher-frame fittings as privately paid civilian convalescent-home supplies, produces/holds her signed work order/receipt and protests that the classified delay costs her and her customer; her two loaders remain by her cart. VOS answers with his own perspective without deception proof: official inventory instructions cover military transport equipment/empty sealed cases, and he insists on verifying category before releasing cargo for fear of personal accountability; he does NOT claim the six civilian fittings are individually named on his legal military requisition. When Cirren independently asks whether Vos's sheet expressly lists Elen's fittings or the civilian yard entry merely groups them with the cases, Vos acknowledges the latter is what needs checking; he points toward the civilian yard checker. This dialogue is an independently professional disagreement, not evidence of any specific corrupt intent, proof of authority to impound Elen's civilian property or permission to seize/detain V. Sella independently goes toward the civilian inventory checker in office, where two numbered registers lie open, but has NOT yet brought a confirmed reconciliation/serial-number result to V; actual document comparison, any correction/release, private military itinerary, service or secret site lead remain unplayed. Two ordinary logistics guards at gate and two cargo loaders remain in ordinary peaceful positions, no attack, threat or force. V/Cirren accompany conversation and see the clerks/registers by sight, neither performs Investigation, Insight, Persuasion nor special spell check; no check necessary to hear each participant's freely offered public account. All party stats/resources, personal money and owned gear unchanged; Day279 morning food/feed already deducted to18 ration-person-days/24 horse-feed-days; V purse969gp3sp6cp. V HP48/48 HD7/7, Cirren51/51 HD6/6 full slots, Fenar59/59 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6, Mara healthy, own four horses/coach intact, Pixie Dust qty1 unopened. LongRest3/6; it remains Day279 ~10:05 and daytime d10090 already occurred with no random event, no next roll/overnight. V's next decision unresolved: seek actual numbered invoice comparison through independent clerk, ask further questions, or leave with caravan. This is a small ongoing dialogue, not an actual sync boundary; no sync_trigger.

PLAY-REC-D279-YARD-SETTLEMENT-AND-PATIENT-LEAD-001
Exact player in-character request ~Day279 10:05 at first staffed eastbound freight receiving yard: "We’d love to resolve this in a timely and civilized manner. Is there anything we can help with?" Player offers peaceful assistance, NOT an unlimited V duty, money, formal witnessing signature, political allegiance or V fight. Civilian forewoman Elen Turr welcomes witnesses to her six privately paid iron stretcher-frame fittings destined for civilian convalescent home; military logistics Sgt Adren Vos agrees that neutral witnesses may be present provided actual regulations are observed. Harrow & Pike wagonmaster Sella Brant independently goes to open civilian checker registers and is willing to witness orderly category comparison while company cargo is being processed. The professional civilian clerk compares numbered records WITHOUT any ability roll since the prepared facts are written, accessible and objectively unambiguous: civilian invoice #47 identifies SIX civilian stretcher-frame fittings with convalescent-home destination; the genuinely valid military requisition lists TWO EMPTY MILITARY-MARKED TRANSPORT CASES with distinct serials. Yard receiving clerk mistakenly grouped both under broad 'transport equipment' category. Public records show military authorization covers the empty cases only, not the fittings or civilian workers. Sergeant Vos accepts the verified distinction and orders Elen's civilian wagon released, retaining only the two separately owned military transport cases for actual lawful inventory pickup. Elen thanks those present and is free to continue her original contract delivery; Vos's military duty remains and he admits procedural delay without being forced to confess corruption; neither adult is harmed, humiliated by fiat, detained, robbed, recruited or forced to become V's ally. Sella comments with relief that no arrest, loss or delay need continue, but her own three freight wagons' regular manifest processing is not necessarily complete the instant Elen is released. The ordinary civic/freight problem is RESOLVED in daylight ~Day279 10:10, no Persuasion/Investigation/Insight dice, no payment, reward, expended consumables, official law changed or V signature assumed.
At this real contact one of the EXISTING four Station Kestrel support workers KN-S1 in eligible Day278 preauthored prep is present at yard to collect exactly the TWO EMPTY military cases in an ordinary horse-drawn cart, distinct from Elen's wagon/Sella's three wagons. KN-S1's prior current knowledge from firsthand work includes eleven living detained patients, six awake, three unable to walk, two frightened and restrained, and painful nonconsensual trials observed personally. KN-S1 has independent reason to seek outside protection, notices V's civilized help and visibly capable adventuring party, cautiously approaches V quietly while staying away from Sgt Vos, and requests a private word. Their introductory warning, if shared to V within quiet speaking distance, is limited to a credible first-person description: "I carry supplies to a recovery station. Eleven people are being kept there. Three can't walk, and others are restrained. I've watched them hurt people. They need to get out." The person offers to explain where and what they know if V willingly listens; do NOT automatically transfer the worker's copied duty sheet, exact itinerary, military route code or infer all testimony is independently proven. Station's four support workers are conserved: KN-S1 now at yard in their precommitted actual cart and thus not simultaneously present at station until actual return. They are not a new V companion and have no right to conscript V or Sella. They do NOT know Glass Spear or the hidden deaths, and no details of that history exposed. Sgt Vos knows his military-case assignment but not the experimentation, is not automatically tipped off by this quiet exchange or compelled to arrest the worker. One potential meaningful optional expedition/protection lead is now verbally INTRODUCED but neither accepted nor promised by V. The civilian trust's potential compensation is NOT yet offered; do not invent a reward promise. No change to private detention state other than KN-S1 traveling for existing resupply and no automatic prisoner rescue.
All party resources at ~Day279 10:10 unchanged: V48/48 HP HD7/7, Sup4/4 Psi6/6 MP7/7 full action abilities; Cirren51/51 HD6/6 full slots; Fenar59/59 HD6/6 Rage4/4 Shift3/3 MP6/6, Mara healthy; V personal purse969gp3sp6cp, carried rations18 person-days/horse feed24 animal-days, four owned healthy horses and intact coach with caravan at yard, one unopened Pixie Dust V-owned; LongRest3/6. Day279 daytime d10090 quiet already adjudicated. No additional game time beyond minutes, random encounter, night/rest, spell use, coin or item custody change. Quest hook not automatically accepted; V next decision whether to hear private witness or continue toward Eastwatch. This completes the distinct onstage civilian dispute and counts as legitimate quest milestone for automatic natural-boundary sync: include validated top-level sync_trigger marker with reason quest_milestone and exact last recovery/destination fields, never manually create a PR or call queued without confirmed PR.
